Message:
“However, to think you’d
offer your life to a demon.
Humans prove that their
arrogance is as endearing as ever.
I don’t know if I can bear
the thought of killing you.”

Black flames then began
to close in on me.
But, these were no ordinary flames.

From within them,
I heard the resounding cries of
humans writhing in agony...

“Although...death may indeed
prove to be more peaceful for you.”

“...I’ll have you keep
your promise...!”

“Demons do not lie.
Entertain me,
and I will set this body free.”

I most certainly won’t
make it out of this alive.
But if it means saving her...

“I’ll give you my life,
damn demon!
For Lady Elfriede,
I’ll die as many times
as it takes!”

I threw myself into the flames.
I felt them burn away my soul,
trying to destroy me from within.

But, this pain is nothing compared
to what she has had to endure...

—There is no other way for
me to atone for my sins...
than to pay with my life...

Lady Elfriede...!
So, you truly intend to
atone with your life.

That may be your
ultimate decision,
but I...!

“I want you...to live...!
No matter what sins
you may have committed...!”

I have failed as a knight.
For I stand here
not to fulfill your wish,

but to selfishly fulfill my own.
My wish for you to keep living.

“This is the first time
I am defying you.
Please...don’t give up on living...”

In the next instant,
the flames burned
more violently,
and began to consume
my entire body.

I accept my fate...
Lady Elfriede’s sins...
are my sins...
I will bear them all.

Let every last sin...
burn away...with me...
